title: 第二十六章 大风起云飞扬人逍遥
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
沈君壁走向坐在石墩子上沉默了半个时辰的侯紫说，“怎么啦？”

    侯紫手心有微风在打着旋，一会聚一会散。回了一句。

    “你说风系功法是怎么样的，是灵力引起风的共鸣吗？”

    “据我所知，有风系灵根的修士，能引导外部的风灵力进入体内，在体内储存，用的时候释放的一个过程。当然，还需要有对应功法进行引导储存。”

    “昨天打的那场架，我感觉我从之前能控制微风改变为能控制大风了。好像比之前要强了，但是还找不到方法，有效的控制。”

    “要么你再看看那本奇书。”

    侯紫听了，把借势经拿出来，翻开第一页，上面的痕纹还跟原来的一样。侯紫盯着看，突然觉得那些痕纹在扩大，不像之前那么细了，联想到之前干架时的感受，侯紫忽然明白了，借的风大了。侯紫拿起笔，在书页上写下。

    大风起，云飞扬，人逍遥。

    借势经开始发烫，第一页上的痕纹像在刮风一样出现了一系列的变化，那痕纹越发粗大，好像风大了，充实了。

    侯紫看懂了，那是风能推动大石头了，不是原来只能推动碎片。

    沈君壁明显感觉侯紫的气势变了，一种迎风而上的气势扑面而来。

    侯紫欢喜极了，招呼沈君壁赶紧来看。沈君壁凑上去，看了下借势经，还是看不懂，但总有一种感觉，这些新出现的痕纹好像跟自己画符时的符文变化能有触动，只是暂时想不出来。

    侯紫对沈君壁说，“修士修炼有境界，之前的境界我叫它微风，如今应该叫大风了。”

    沈君壁很无语，“你这认不了几个字的小子也起不来多风雅的名字，这奇书可所托非人了。”

    侯紫嘿嘿一笑，“我心里知道就行，高雅的名字有什么用，不懂还是不懂。”

    就在这时，炼器铺来了一队人马，还没进门，就在大叫。

    “那个昨天打了张麻子的兄弟在吗？”

    “快叫他出来。”

    为首的是个虎背熊腰的壮汉，炼气中期修为，腰间挂着一把没有刀鞘的短刀，刀柄上缠着旧布条。他跨进炼器铺的门槛，目光扫了一圈，落在坐在石墩子上的侯紫身上。
content_en:
Shen Junbi walked towards Hou Zi, who had been sitting on the stone pier in silence for half an hour, and said, "What's the matter?"

There was a breeze swirling in Hou Zi's palm, gathering and dispersing.replied.

"What do you think the wind technique is like? Is it the spiritual power that resonates with the wind?"

"As far as I know, monks with wind spiritual roots can guide the external wind spiritual power into the body, store it in the body, and release it when used. Of course, there is also a need for corresponding skills to guide and store it."

"In the fight yesterday, I felt that I had changed from being able to control the breeze to being able to control the strong wind. It seemed to be stronger than before, but I still couldn't find a way to control it effectively."

"Either you read that strange book again."

After hearing this, Hou Zi took out the Book of Utilization and turned to the first page. The marks on it were still the same as before.Hou Zi stared at it, and suddenly felt that the marks were expanding and were not as thin as before. Thinking of the feeling during the previous fight, Hou Zi suddenly understood that the wind was getting stronger.Hou Zi picked up the pen and wrote on the page.

The wind blows, the clouds fly, and people are at ease.

Taking advantage of the situation, the sutra began to heat up, and the lines on the first page underwent a series of changes as if they were blowing in the wind. The lines became thicker and thicker, as if the wind was getting stronger and more substantial.

Hou Zi understood that it was the wind that could push the big rocks, instead of the original ones that could only push the fragments.

Shen Junbi clearly felt that Hou Zi's aura had changed, and a kind of aura blowing up to the wind came to his face.

Hou Zi was very happy and called Shen Junbi to come and see.Shen Junbi moved closer and looked at the Sutra of Utilizing Power, but he still couldn't understand it, but he always had a feeling that these new marks seemed to be related to the changes in the runes when he drew the runes, but he couldn't figure it out for the time being.

Hou Zi said to Shen Junbi, "Monks have a state of cultivation. I called the previous state a breeze, but now it should be called a strong wind."

Shen Junbi was speechless, "You, a boy who can't read a few words and can't come up with an elegant name, can't trust anyone with this wonderful book."

Hou Zi chuckled, "As long as I know it in my heart, what's the use of an elegant name? If you don't understand, you still don't understand."

At this moment, a team of people came to the weapon refining shop, and they were shouting before they even entered the door.

"Is the brother who beat Zhang Mazi yesterday here?"

"Call him out quickly."

The leader was a sturdy man with a strong back and a strong waist. He was in the middle stage of Qi refining. There was a short sword without a scabbard hanging on his waist, and an old cloth strip was wrapped around the handle.He stepped into the threshold of the weapon refining shop, glanced around, and landed on Hou Zi sitting on the stone pier.
title_en: Chapter 26 The strong wind raises the clouds and makes people happy
